text:
I'd run this now. Pausing is reversible and doesn't need your sign-off.

```sh
sudo tentmaker pause --json --for 6h gaming
tentmaker budget --json
```

The second command confirms the pause took effect and shows the current profile and why.

I picked 6 hours so CI comes back on its own if you forget to resume. If you'd rather have a different length (`--for 3h`, `--for 10h`), tell me and I'll rerun it. To end it early:

```sh
sudo tentmaker resume
```

I don't know from the docs whether a pause stops jobs already running or just stops new ones from starting. I'd read that from the `budget --json` output and tell you before your game starts.

If you game often, the `guards` config can pause CI automatically whenever a process you list (your game) is running. I'd only set that up if you ask.
